solution: Distance = √(7² + 24²) = 25 km.

subject: Reasoning
question: Facing west, a man turns left, then left again. Which direction is he facing?

solution: West → left = south → left = east.
solutionHi: पश्चिम → बाएँ = दक्षिण → बाएँ = पूर्व।

question: Statements: All teachers are honest. Some honest people are rich. Conclusions: I. Some teachers are rich. II. Some honest people are teachers.

optionBHi: केवल निष्कर्ष II अनुसरण करता है
optionCHi: I और II दोनों अनुसरण करते हैं
optionDHi: न तो I और न ही II अनुसरण करता है
solution: All teachers are honest gives II; rich honest people need not be teachers, so I is uncertain.
solutionHi: सभी शिक्षक ईमानदार हैं इसलिए II; धनी ईमानदार लोग शिक्षक हों यह ज़रूरी नहीं, इसलिए I अनिश्चित।
